input.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photo, a single frame from a phone-shot UGC video. Shot on a phone, natural light, realistic, casual like a real person filmed it, no cinematic grading. Bright, clean, neutral exposure (no dark or moody look, no yellow or golden tint). No on-screen text, captions or logos. Reference images, in order: Grace's hand reference sheet (skin, nails, rings, bracelets); the flashlight's front view (main reference); the flashlight reference sheet (every side).
